items.title: Uganda says it has no active Ebola cases, but infections in Kenya and Nigeria are prompting fresh scrutiny

items.title: Serbia votes as student-led bloc challenges longtime leader Vucic

items.title: Fernandes dropped to Man Utd bench - was Carrick right?

items.title: Harry Kane: Ballon d’Or for Bayern Munich striker?
items.excerpt: Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane is the clear front-runner for football's most prestigious individual prize, which will be awarded on Monday. Kane has developed even more in the Bundesliga despite an uneven league.
